verdict.rationale: Insomnia's Design view lets users preview an OpenAPI spec (insomnia-docs-16), auto-lint it (insomnia-docs-17), and generate code snippets in 12+ languages (insomnia-docs-18), while collections let users actually send/run those requests against the spec (insomnia-docs-5, insomnia-docs-9). This gives a de facto 'explore + run' experience, but there's no evidence of a dedicated, AI-native-branded interactive API reference (e.g., a hosted reference page with clickable runnable examples akin to Swagger UI/Postman docs) tailored for this persona. Missing for 10: a purpose-built interactive reference/playground UI, AI-native framing or agent-consumable reference format, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
